The work

Listing photography

Standard Quick Shoot

general listings · edited, watermarked · delivered in 24–48 hours

Exclusive Shoot

properties above AED 10,000,000 · 5–7 hour shoot, detailed post-production · delivered in 5–7 working days

Before you raise the camera: the property should be clean, organized and accessible, with occupants, pets and hazards managed; if the agent isn't attending, keys are with the coordinator a day ahead. Not ready? Flag the coordinator: shoot time is not staging time.

Provident — Photography Guideline03

The work

PVH · holiday homes

Provident Holiday Homes lives on booking platforms, where the photos are the product. PVH shoots are high-quality, guest-ready and curated; every frame earns its place in the listing.

Standard

Curated, not exhaustive

A tight set of hero frames beats a full walkthrough. Style the space guest-ready before shooting: beds dressed, amenities out, branded touches in place.

Look

Bright, warm, lived-in

Balanced daylight, warm accents, and the details a guest books for: the view, the terrace, the coffee corner. Shoot the experience, not just the floor plan.

Provident — Photography Guideline04

The work

Company profile portraits

Agent and staff portraits are shot inside the office, then cropped and composited onto the company backdrop for the website. The photographer's job is a clean, consistent source frame; graphics handles the rest.

Pose & attire

Formal, angled, smiling

Formal attire, always. The torso faces the right side of frame with the right hand resting on top of the left, elegant and composed. Eyes look straight into the camera, with a smile.

The pin

Provident pin, left of the torso

The Provident pin is mandatory on every profile portrait, worn on the left side of the torso. Confirm it's in place before the first frame.

Frame & light

Guide layer, clean separation

Compose to the company framing guide (right): subject centered, eye line and crop zones on the marked lines. Light evenly with clean edges; the background gets replaced, so the subject must cut out cleanly.

Provident — Photography Guideline05

The work

Visa photos

Employee visa photos follow the UAE visa photo standard. These get rejected over small things; shoot strictly to the checklist and the retake rate stays at zero.

Non-negotiable

White background, full face, both ears

Pure white background, even light, and no shadows on the face or across the top of the frame. Face fully visible and sharp: both eyes open, all features clear, both ears visible, facing the camera straight on. No smiling; a relaxed, neutral expression.

High rejection risk

Keep it plain

For female staff: avoid excessive jewellery, false eyelashes and heavy makeup; these are the most common rejection reasons. Nothing covering the face or hairline that isn't worn daily.

Frame

Head and shoulders, centered

Head centered with clear space above, shoulders square. Deliver uncropped at full resolution; the coordinator sizes it per application.

Provident — Photography Guideline06

The work

AI furniture staging

Empty units get virtually furnished after the shoot. Allow about a week for staging on top of the normal delivery time.

The limitation

One angle per room

Generating multiple angles of the same room isn't possible; the furniture won't stay consistent between views. Pick the one hero angle per room and shoot it clean.

Shoot for it

Wide, level, uncluttered

A straight, wide, well-exposed empty frame gives the AI the best canvas. Declutter fully; anything left in the room ends up in the render.

Provident — Photography Guideline07

Delivery

Watermark & delivery

≈ 30% of frame width
8%
8%

The wordmark sits bottom-left: white, ≈30% of the frame width, with an 8% margin from the left and bottom edges. Same position on every image, every shoot.

Watermark

One lockup, one position

White Provident wordmark, bottom-left, sized and placed per the diagram. Never recolored, boxed, rotated or moved to fit the composition; the composition works around it.

Two versions

Watermarked + clean

Every image is delivered in both versions: watermarked for listing and marketing use, and clean (no watermark) for approved internal needs.

Platform

Google Drive, link to the agent

Both versions upload to Google Drive in the shoot's folder; the link is then shared with the agent. No loose files over chat or email.
